_about: Turn animations, measured through the viewer's own clipFor -- the clip it PLAYS, retargeted onto the model by global bone id. NOT the raw motion file: its node 00 track is in a different basis and gave angles off by more than 100 degrees (Seregios' Motion[51] read -32.5 there against -177 here), which is why this is generated inside the page rather than by a second implementation. A turn animation is the BODY turning while the engine carries the heading, so node 00 leans out and comes home: reach over 25 degrees, net under 15, under 120 frames. `deg` is that lean and is how far the viewer moves the turn target; `pair` is the clip of the same list and length leaning the other way -- left and right of one turn. REGENERATE: window.__view.clipFor over every monster's lists, the same rule, as in scratchpad/vgen.js. The rule is the viewer's, not the ROM's -- the ROM's own label for a turn is in the action layer and is not read.
